established_public_context.source: National Museum of Nature and Science, Japan — Japanese Cirsium database
established_public_context.interpretation: diploid chromosome context; haploid chromosome complement x=17

public_2C_genome_size_audit.boundary: absence is search-bounded, not proof that no unpublished, non-indexed, or inaccessible measurement exists

aza3_requirement: Measure same-individual 2C genome size by flow cytometry for focal genomic samples where feasible.
Retain chromosome/ploidy and continuous 2C genome size as separate variables.
Do not treat 2n=34 as evidence of equivalent genome architecture across Cirsium.
Use focal 2C data as mapping/callability and structural-interpretation QC before phenotype-linked genomic inference.
nature_claim_boundary: Known diploidy lowers one source of ambiguity but does not authorize assuming a shared genome size or structurally equivalent reference architecture.
